summary.interpretation: Multiple demonstrated sensitivities, not proof of one universal cause. Small selected diagnostic samples are not independent webcam benchmarks.

offline.scope: 75 train / 19 val; test never loaded; no production training or data edits

probe_specification.mlp: StandardScaler + MLP(64 ReLU, alpha=.01, max_iter=500, seed=42)
probe_specification.selection: Fixed diagnostics, no hyperparameter search or production replacement

phase_controls.source: target-blind medians of training-only pre/hand-span/post frame counts

live.user_confirmation: Completed all six; capture was normal

camera.selection: First two validation-index rows of each HELLO/THANKYOU/NO, regardless of prediction

scale_isolation.selection: First original-correct / reduced-scale-wrong row in prespecified six-video control. Explanatory selection, not a new evaluation set.
scale_isolation.limits: Restoring groups is a controlled transplant between two renderings of the same public video; neither detector output is ground-truth joints.
